title: Chapter 268: Cerberus Cavalry
content:
Chapter 268: Cerberus Cavalry

As he said this, he hurriedly tried to order the other three-headed hellhounds to submit through Da Huang to see if he could do it.

Da Huang immediately "woofed".

A mountain dog slightly smaller than Da Huang came out.

"Gong Zheng, go up and try it."

Gong Zheng walked over slowly. Although the three-headed dog was a little timid, it did not run away. When Gong Zheng jumped on it, it began to struggle violently.

It took Gong Zheng to jump around. After a cigarette, it stopped struggling and was completely tamed by Gong Zheng.

Seeing that it was feasible, Wang Shuo smiled.

He formed a cavalry unit of three-headed hellhounds.

After returning to the territory, Ayub had just returned not long ago!

"Lord, the matter has been settled!"

"Radul, Guan Jie and others have also left!"

Wang Shuo nodded. After these spies were released, they could continue to penetrate other towns and provide intelligence for Wang Shuo's next plan.

"Abu, I need to select some good players from the Golden Fire Cavalry to form a Cerberus Cavalry Unit."

"Lord, how many people do you need?"

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to select 500 people first!

Afterwards, Wang Shuo selected 500 Golden Fire Cavalry and prepared to enter the breeding space of the Cerberus.

At this time, Wang Shuo found that he could no longer enter this space.

What's the situation?

After defeating the boss, can this space no longer be entered?

Afterwards, he summoned Da Huang and was able to summon it out.

Fortunately!

Wang Shuo could only accept this reality. This space can only accommodate Cerberus now.

Wang Shuo had to let Da Huang select 500 Cerberus from it and let the cavalry tame it.

Half an hour later, all the soldiers were riding on the Cerberus.

Wang Shuo was very excited.

Now he urgently needs a battle to test the strength of this alien beast unit.

Enter the ancient battlefield.

After adjusting the level of the undead to level 40, Wang Shuo led the three-headed dog troops and immediately launched an attack.

After a fierce battle, Wang Shuo could only describe this battle as crushing.

The combat power exceeded Wang Shuo's imagination. Compared with the golden fire cavalry, the combat power was directly doubled.

After returning to the territory, Wang Shuo was still not satisfied!

Now, the placement of the three-headed hellhounds has become a problem. If they are put back in the breeding space, the cooperation between the soldiers and the mounts will inevitably be unfamiliar. If they are raised outside, a new barracks will have to be built.

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to put all the three-headed dogs in the breeding space.

After all, that is their home.

Just need to let the soldiers and mounts cooperate and train regularly, there should be no big problem with combat effectiveness.

At this time, Chang Gui's "body" was also ready.

The woodworking workshop sent someone to deliver a wooden man.

After seeing it, Wang Shuo just wanted to laugh.

Round wooden head, round wooden body, only arms and legs, still a bit human-like.

Chang Gui was so excited when he saw the wooden man.

This kind of gloomy wood can better nourish his soul. Although he is a wooden man, he can live in the real world after all. This has been his wish for many years.

The previous lords have not been able to do this.

He quickly got out of the "Survivor's Manual".

A black smoke floated into the wooden man.

In an instant, the wooden man's hands and feet moved mechanically, and then the arc of the movement became larger and larger, and soon he was able to walk.

"Lord, please give me the certificate of priest transfer!" Chang Gui said excitedly.

Wang Shuo saw Chang Gui's anxious look and did not keep him in suspense.

After he changed his job, the wooden man's round wood actually had facial features.

Eyes, nose, mouth, one by one.

Wang Shuo was stunned.
